decided_by: Người dùng xác nhận các đề xuất mặc định D1–D6 trong TASKS_HOAN_THIEN.md; D4 chọn sampled softmax CE vì máy không có GPU CUDA.

locked_protocol.note: Giao thức đã chốt ở notebook 01/02; không đổi khi chưa có xác nhận của người dùng.
locked_protocol.new_session_condition: visitor changes OR consecutive event gap > threshold
locked_protocol.split_unit: whole session; sessions crossing a cutoff -> boundary_drop
locked_protocol.boundary_drop_usage: never used as history, candidate source or label

samples.query: prefix = groups 1..t of a session (t >= 1); one query per t < n_groups
samples.query_time_ms: timestamp of group t (last prefix group)
samples.target: set of distinct itemid in group t+1, all behaviors; original IDs kept even when out of vocabulary
samples.prefix_storage: not materialised; read events_sessionized by session_id and group_index <= prefix_len_groups

vocabulary.source: every itemid in train events, including single-group sessions
vocabulary.trainval_variant: same rule on train + validation events, used only for the D2 refit before test

metadata.as_of_rule: latest update with timestamp <= t (merge_asof direction=backward, by itemid)
metadata.missing: unknown; never filled from the future

rules: itemid in the vocabulary of the fitting data
latest available with timestamp <= t != 0 (unknown is kept)

known_at.train: known_at_train_ms = min(first train event, first property record of any property)
known_at.train_validation: known_at_trainval_ms = min(first train/validation event, first property record)

candidates.applies_to: every model and the Popularity fallback
candidates.fallback: Popularity ranking of the fitting data, uniform behavior weights unless the tuned weights are better on validation
candidates.missing_slots: if fewer than K eligible items remain, empty slots count as misses

repeat_targets.flag: target_is_repeat per (query, item): item appears anywhere in the prefix
repeat_targets.baseline: Repeat-last: prefix items by most recent group, ties by stronger behavior then itemid; filled by Popularity fallback
repeat_targets.optional_ablation: merge consecutive groups with the same (item, behavior) set — not run unless time allows

long_sessions.gru_train_truncation: sessions longer than 51 groups are cut into windows of at most 51 groups (overlap 1 group); hidden state resets at each window; evaluation uses the full prefix

refit.refit_rule: same configuration; GRU uses the epoch count selected on validation; vocabulary, popularity, similarities, session store and known_at recomputed on train+validation
refit.test_runs: each variant evaluated on test exactly once after freezing

gru4rec.input_per_step: mean item embedding of the timestamp group + mean behavior embedding (view/addtocart/transaction)
gru4rec.loss: sampled softmax cross-entropy: in-batch positives + popularity-sampled shared negatives with log-Q correction; accidental hits masked
gru4rec.multi_item_targets: uniform label split: each correct item gets weight 1/|G|
gru4rec.oov_input_items: mapped to PAD (ignored in the group mean); behavior embedding still used
ablations: shuffle group order inside the prefix

evaluation.gain: binary; log2 discount; IDCG over min(|G|, K) positions
evaluation.denominator: every query with non-empty target, including out-of-vocabulary targets (score 0)
